title: 1st Sitting of third session of 2025

items.text: Opening recitation (Hamd and Salawat); the sitting begins.
Roll call of members present at the sitting.
Announcement of the day's agenda (Agenda No. އޖ/1/3/2025).
Approval of the minutes of five previous sittings (minutes Nos. 23/2/2025 to 27/2/2025).

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission, under Article 115(d) of the Constitution and Article 14 of Law No. 20/2021 (Foreign Service Act), to appoint non-resident ambassadors to foreign countries is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission to appoint 4 members to the National Integrity Commission under Article 11 of Law No. 27/2015 (National Integrity Commission Act) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission to appoint 2 members to the Tax Appeal Tribunal under Article 56(a)(1) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act) is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's request, under Articles 115(f)(2) and 93(a) of the Constitution, for Parliament's consent to accept and ratify the "Instrument for the Acceptance of the 1986 Constitutional Amendment" is sent to the relevant standing committee.

From the Speaker's desk: the President's submission, under Article 190(b) of the Constitution and Article 5 of Law No. 6/2006 (Human Rights Commission Act), to appoint a member to the Human Rights Commission is sent to the relevant standing committee.

First reading of the resolution submitted by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez calling for the corruption flagged in the Auditor General's special audit report on Fenaka Corporation Limited to be investigated and acted on quickly.
First reading of Galolhu North MP Mohamed Ibrahim's bill amending Law No. 5/2009 (Land Transport Act).
Preliminary debate on the Re-employment Bill, submitted on behalf of the government by Guraidhoo MP Hanaan Mohamed Rasheed.

Preliminary debate on the resolution submitted by Madaveli MP Mohamed Shameez calling for the corruption flagged in the Auditor General's special audit report on Fenaka Corporation Limited to be investigated and acted on quickly.
Voting on items from the day's business that have reached the voting stage.

summary: The first sitting of the session approved old minutes, sent five presidential appointment and treaty submissions to committees, introduced the Fenaka resolution and a Land Transport Act amendment, and opened debate on the Re-employment Bill and the Fenaka resolution.
